title: No file path management for recordings
description: MeetingSession has mediaFilePath property but there's no logic to generate unique file paths, ensure directory exists, or manage storage location. Need to implement file system handling with proper sandboxing and cleanup.

title: No model download handling for WhisperKit
description: WhisperKit initialization downloads models on first run, which can take several minutes and fail on poor network. No progress indication, retry logic, or offline handling. User will see app freeze or unexplained errors.

title: TranscriptSegment lacks Identifiable conformance
description: SessionListView uses List(session.segments) expecting Identifiable, but TranscriptSegment doesn't have id property or conform to Identifiable. This will cause compilation errors or runtime issues.

title: AudioUtils uses print() instead of Logger
description: AudioUtils.swift:40 uses print() for error logging. Should use OSLog Logger for proper structured logging.

title: No UI for permissions state
description: PermissionsService tracks permission state but there's no UI to display it or guide user through granting permissions. App will silently fail to record if permissions are denied. Need onboarding flow or permission status view.

title: No tests for core audio/video pipeline
description: PipelineTests.swift has one basic test that doesn't verify actual functionality. Missing tests for: audio mixing, resampling, timestamp sync, video compositing, file writing, transcription integration. Critical functionality is untested.

title: SessionListView.addItem creates fake sessions
description: The addItem() function creates dummy MeetingSession objects for testing, but this functionality is exposed in production UI. Should remove this debug feature or hide it behind a debug flag.

title: No permissions checking before capture
description: startCapture() doesn't verify microphone/camera/screen recording permissions before attempting to start AVCaptureSession and SCStream. Will fail with cryptic errors instead of clear permission prompt. PermissionsService exists but isn't integrated with CaptureService.

title: No cancellation of in-flight transcription
description: When stopCapture() is called, transcription tasks may still be running. No mechanism to cancel ongoing transcription, potentially causing crashes or delays when stopping recording.

title: Unsafe Sendable conformance patterns
description: CaptureService uses @unchecked Sendable and accesses non-isolated state (avSession, stream) from multiple queues without proper synchronization. This violates Swift 6 concurrency safety. Need to make mutable state actor-isolated or properly synchronized with locks/queues.

title: Transcription service not persisting to SwiftData
description: TranscriptionService creates TranscriptSegment objects but never saves them to the SwiftData database. There's no MeetingSession creation, no modelContext injection, and segments are discarded after logging. Need to integrate with SwiftData persistence layer.

title: startCapture calls setupAVSession twice
description: CaptureService.startCapture() calls setupAVSession() which was already called in init(). This is redundant and could cause issues if session is already configured. Need to refactor initialization vs start logic.

title: RecordingView uses print() instead of Logger
description: RecordingView.swift:39 uses print() for error logging, violating SwiftLint rules and best practices. Should use OSLog Logger consistently.

title: No actual recording start/stop flow
description: When recording stops, no MeetingSession is created or saved. The captured audio/video/transcription is lost. Need to implement session creation at start, accumulate data during recording, and save to SwiftData on stop with proper file paths.

title: Incorrect WhisperKit API usage
description: TranscriptionService calls `whisperKit.transcribe(audioArray:)` and expects array of results, but WhisperKit returns a single result with segments array. Current code will fail or produce incorrect output. Need to fix return type handling and properly extract segments with timestamps.

title: Missing timestamp tracking for transcription
description: TranscriptSegments are created with hardcoded startTime=0.0 and approximate endTime. No tracking of actual recording start time, no CMTime handling, no way to correlate transcript with video timeline. Need session-level timestamp management and proper CMTime conversion.

title: No video recording/writing implementation
description: According to the architecture spec, the app should record screen+webcam video using AVAssetWriter with HEVC encoding and CoreImage compositing for PiP. Currently CaptureService captures video frames but never writes them to disk. The entire video pipeline (AVAssetWriter, CoreImage compositor, CVPixelBuffer handling) is missing.

title: No screen capture filter to prevent feedback loop
description: Architecture spec warns about excluding app from screen capture to prevent feedback. CaptureService.swift:205 attempts this but uses Bundle.main.bundleIdentifier which may not work correctly in all contexts. Need to verify this actually prevents capture of own windows.

title: No audio recording to disk
description: Audio samples are captured and sent to transcription, but never written to the video file's audio track. Need to implement AVAssetWriter audio input with proper CMSampleBuffer handling and clock synchronization.

title: Missing Info.plist usage descriptions
description: Info.plist exists but needs NSMicrophoneUsageDescription, NSCameraUsageDescription entries for permission prompts. Without these, system won't prompt for permissions and will deny access silently.

title: Fix SwiftLint errors blocking build
description: SwiftLint is failing the build due to line length violations and code style issues. The build cannot proceed until these are resolved. Main error is line 107 in AudioProcessor.swift exceeding 150 character limit.

title: Implement Core Audio Logic
description: Implement AudioProcessor and CaptureService delegates with thread-safe concurrency handling. Fix build errors related to Sendable checks.

title: Memory leak in stopCapture
description: stopCapture() creates reference to stream then uses it in Task without clearing the instance variable. If stopCapture is called multiple times, multiple Tasks will be created. Should nil out stream after stopping and handle already-stopped case.

title: ContentView duplicates isRecording state
description: ContentView has @State isRecording that shadows CaptureService.isRecording. These can get out of sync. Should use single source of truth from CaptureService.

title: CaptureService initialization race conditions
description: CaptureService.init() calls async setupAVSession() without awaiting, and initializeServices() can be called before setup completes. This creates race conditions. The isInitialized flag doesn't protect against concurrent initialization attempts. Need proper initialization lifecycle management.

title: Excessive buffering causes memory growth
description: AudioProcessor buffers up to 5 minutes of audio (maxBufferSize = 16000 * 60 * 5 = 4.8M samples ≈ 19MB). With dual sources, this is 38MB RAM minimum. Need to process and flush more frequently, or stream to disk.

title: No Voice Activity Detection (VAD)
description: Architecture spec mentions using WhisperKit's VAD to avoid processing silence. Currently all audio chunks are sent to transcription regardless of content, wasting compute and battery. Need to implement VAD checking before transcription.

title: No audio source mixing implementation
description: Architecture spec requires mixing system audio and microphone into a combined stream with proper timestamp alignment. Currently both sources are processed separately without synchronization or mixing. Need ring buffer, CMClock alignment, and stereo channel mapping (L=System, R=Mic) as per spec.

title: Hardcoded sample rate detection
description: AudioProcessor.detectSampleRate() returns hardcoded values (44.1kHz for mic, 48kHz for system) instead of reading actual format from CMSampleBuffer. This will cause resampling errors if actual rates differ. Need to extract real sample rate from AudioStreamBasicDescription.

title: Unused AVAudioConverter resampler code
description: AudioProcessor has getResampler() method creating AVAudioConverter instances but they're never used. resampleAudio() uses simple linear interpolation instead. Dead code should be removed or the proper AVAudioConverter path should be implemented for better quality.

title: No error recovery in capture pipeline
description: If AVCaptureSession or SCStream encounters an error during recording, the app has no recovery mechanism. Errors are logged but capture continues in broken state. Need proper error handling, state recovery, and user notification with option to restart.
